generations.prompt: Create four-frame warm hand-painted RPG walking animation of the SAME brown-haired male worker in image1 (yellow rolled sleeves, brown leather apron, brown trousers and boots). Image2 is the handcart whose handles he will PUSH, but do NOT draw cart or any props. Worker must face RIGHT in all four frames and hold BOTH empty palms extended forward toward RIGHT at waist height, gripping imaginary horizontal handcart handles. Both hands remain fixed relative to his torso across frames, not swing while he walks. Elevated oblique40degree-down perspective matching image1. Exactly4 full-body separate sprites in one horizontal row, equal cells and broad transparent gutters. Frame1 LEFT boot clearly forward, RIGHT boot clearly behind; frame2 left planted, right passes directly under hips; frame3 RIGHT boot clearly forward, LEFT boot behind (OPPOSITE leading leg to frame1); frame4 right planted,left passes hips. Distinguish both trouser legs with overlap; do not merely duplicate the same stride. Flat grounded contact feet, consistent skull/head size, same standing calibration body scale and costume from image1. Natural small steady walking steps, no high marching knees. Warm painted gouache and brown outlines matching reference, no pixel-art edges. No cart, no floor, no ground shadows, no labels/text. Actual transparent background.

Edit this four-frame RPG worker push-walk sheet. Preserve ALL heads, faces, torsos, extended arms and empty gripping hands EXACTLY. Keep four equal horizontal cells, body scale, transparent background and painting style. Correct ONLY LEGS AND BOOTS to make a genuine alternating walking cycle. Frame1 leave intact: near-camera leg is extended forward toward right-bottom, other leg trails left. Frame2 passing pose: near-camera leg planted, far leg swings past it with lifted heel. Frame3 must be OPPOSITE of frame1: near-camera thigh bends BACKWARDS to LEFT and its boot is clearly at LEFT-BOTTOM (behind body), far leg crosses IN FRONT and reaches RIGHT, with far boot at RIGHT-UPPER (not right-bottom). Thus the nearest boot is on the LEFT in frame3, while nearest boot is on the RIGHT in frame1. Show clear thigh and knee connection back to the correct hip so legs do not detach. Frame4 opposite passing pose: far leg planted, near leg swings past underneath pelvis. Ordinary small grounded steps, no high knee lift, no skating, no standing with both feet together. Hands stay fixed in the same forward grip through all four frames.
generations.status: adopted after leg revision; one body scale, horizontal head anchor, sole120. Small vertical weight shift up to4px remains; hands can vary slightly vertically during the gait.

generations.prompt: Precise edit of the supplied empty wooden handcart PNG for a warm painted RPG sprite. Preserve the cart bed, BOTH wheels, axle, wheel contact positions, wood/iron details, camera, scale, full canvas and actual transparent background EXACTLY. Change ONLY the two long shafts and the crossbar at their RIGHT ends: they are currently resting very low, almost wheel-bottom height. RAISE their free right ends by about55 pixels relative to this512x320 reference canvas, to a believable standing person's waist height, while keeping their attachment to the cart sides intact. The right-end crossbar should run diagonally between the two shafts, with room for two hands in the middle, and be at roughly y200–215 instead of y260–275. Shaft tips keep their original x positions. This is a handcart with its handles LIFTED for pushing. Do not lift wheels, do not tilt or move the whole bed, do not add person/hands/load. Natural perspective, thin wood handles, same warm painterly shading. No shadows/ground/scenery/text. Keep full512:320 canvas aspect ratio and transparent margins; all original wheel pixels stay at original places.
